blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Elon Musk’s SpaceX on Saturday successfully carried out the first-ever recovery of a spaceship, with its Starship vessel returning safely to its launch pad after a day in orbit. The spaceship emerged from a cloudy sky after a cross-continent descent and, following a controlled descent, slipped smoothly between mechanical “chopstick arms” above Launch Pad 2. Starship’s recovery marked a milestone in the space industry’s decades-long pursuit of fully reusable rocket systems — a goal that can drastically reduce mission costs and make more frequent launches possible. “That was the Holy Grail of spaceflight, plummeting through fire to be snatched […]...
